The '''Tiisheraan system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tiisheraan/Legends|Tiisheraan]], which was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the<ref name="TTTS" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Galen">{{CSWECite|I|184|Derlin, Galen}} establishes that [[Galen Derlin]] was the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]], who was [[Human/Legends|Human]] per {{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20081031.html|text="Fists of Ion"|int=Fists of Ion|newhost=Suvudu}}. Therefore, this article assumes that Galen was Human, as well.</ref> [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Galen Derlin]]<ref name="TTTS" /> and the [[Reproduction/Legends|birthplace]] of<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|184|Derlin, Bren}}</ref> his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren]],<ref name="CSWE Galen">{{CSWECite|I|185|Derlin, Galen}}</ref> as well as another Human, [[Beryann Raleg]].<ref name="RoguesGallery" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tiisheraan [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
